verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for POS software, since open-source POS systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Shopify POS source code published under an open license. The POS UI extensions, the Shopify CLI and API access are developer building blocks for extending the product, not access to the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
